name: Veg Kheema
steps: Pulse cauliflower and carrot briefly to a coarse mince; do not puree. Keep peas whole for colour and bite.
Heat oil and cumin in a wide pan. Fry onion for 7–8 minutes until golden, then add ginger-garlic paste and green chili for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coriander powder and 5 g salt. Cook uncovered for 8 minutes, pressing tomatoes until the masala is thick and nearly dry.
Add minced cauliflower, carrot and peas. Cook uncovered for 8–10 minutes, stirring, until vegetables are tender and excess moisture evaporates.
Finish with remaining salt, garam masala and coriander leaves. Serve the semi-dry vegetable keema with pav or roti.
tips: A coarse mince gives the right texture; finely pureed vegetables release too much water.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
